topic: An egg hatching into a chick and growing into a hen

episode.title: From Tiny Egg to Beautiful Hen

shots.scene: Beautiful nature macro-style photography, vertical 9:16. One pale brown chicken egg rests in a shallow straw nest beside a mossy stone in a sheltered garden nook. Soft natural morning light, blurred green background. Fixed ground-level three-quarter view, framing wide enough for an adult hen in late
shots.action: Show the single intact egg centered in the nest, its smooth shell clearly visible. Establish the nest, mossy stone, lighting, and camera position as permanent visual anchors.

shots.scene: Beautiful nature macro-style photography, vertical 9:16. The same pale brown egg in the same straw nest beside the same mossy stone, with identical soft morning light, blurred garden background, fixed ground-level three-quarter angle, and framing. No other animals, people, text, letters, or logos.
shots.action: The only change is a small star-shaped opening near the egg's broad end, with a tiny beak tip visible through it. Most of the shell remains intact.

shots.action: The shell opening has widened enough to reveal the chick's head and upper body, with damp golden down. Its lower body remains gently cradled inside the shell; no distress or injury.

shots.scene: Beautiful nature macro-style photography, vertical 9:16. The same golden chick is centered in the same straw nest beside the same mossy stone. shots.action: Show the chick fully free of the shell, resting upright with slightly damp down. The two empty shell halves lie immediately beside it. The visible change is complete emergence.

shots.scene: Beautiful nature macro-style photography, vertical 9:16. The same golden chick occupies the same straw nest beside the same mossy stone, with the empty shell halves still beside it. shots.action: Keep the chick approximately the same size and position, but show its down fully dry and softly fluffed into a rounded golden silhouette.

shots.scene: Beautiful nature macro-style photography, vertical 9:16. shots.action: Show the chick beginning to replace its fluffy down with distinct golden-brown wing and tail feathers. Keep its familiar golden face and centered orientation.

Identical soft morning light, blurred garden background, fixed ground-level three-quarter angle, and f
shots.action: Show the next growth stage: a slim young pullet with full golden-brown juvenile plumage and a small pale comb. Preserve the same orientation and recognizable feather coloring.

shots.action: Reveal her mature adult form: a full-bodied golden-brown hen with richly layered feathers and a developed red comb and wattles. Her impressive silhouette fills the space reserved above the original egg.

episode.description: One little egg becomes a beautiful hen in a gentle, step-by-step transformation. Soft natural light and flash-cut transitions reveal every stage. #GlowUpNature #EggToHen #NaturePhotography #GrowingUp #NatureReels
